"},"$:/plugins/keepone/tidme/import/ui/help-shortcuts":{"title":"$:/plugins/keepone/tidme/import/ui/help-shortcuts","caption":"Shortcuts & Manual","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","tags":"[[Tidme Manual]]","text":"|!Shortcut |!Function |!Description |
|[[Alt+K]] |Omni Card Creator |Open global card creator modal anytime|
|[[Alt+X]] |Extract Card |Create an extract card from selected text (inherits document provenance)|
|[[Alt+Z]] |Cloze Card |Create a cloze card from selected text in context|
|[[Alt+Q]] |Q&A Card |Create a question & answer card from selected text|
|[[Ctrl+F7]] |Set Read Point |Anchor read point at currently selected text|
|[[Alt+F7]] |Jump to Read Point |Jump back to read point and highlight text fragment|
|[[Shift+Ctrl+F7]] |Clear Read Point |Remove read point of this document|

!! Section Bar (Top of each Section Card)

* ''Row 1 (Info)'': Breadcrumb · Position X/Y · Cards left to study · Read state · Auto-saved indicator
* ''Row 2 (Actions)'':
** Previous / Next section (automatically advances reading queue)
** ⏸ Set Read Point · ⏮ Jump to Read Point · ✕ Clear Read Point
** ✔ Read (Done, moves out of queue) · ⏩ Later (postpones by A-Factor) · ⚡ Advance (boosts priority into today) · Ignore (mark as unneeded)
** Extract · Cloze · Q&A · More (Priority / A-Factor / Clean extracts / Delete) · Stats · Help

!! Document Page

* ▶ Continue Reading · 📖 Review Book (subset review of book test cards)
* Read Sections (can be re-added) · Extracted & Cloze Cards inbox (with back to source & delete)

!! Reading List (Navigation > Reading)

* Pending reading list: Unread sections/extracts grouped by document, sorted by priority and due date
* Each document group displays progress + "▶ Continue Reading" + "🗑 Clean Reading Materials"; knowledge cards are reviewed in decks

!! Card Manager (Navigation > Manager)

* Views: All / In Queue / Read / Suspended / Overdue
* Organization: By Document / By Deck / Flat List (sortable, batch operations, live preview)
* Actions: Open · Read · Back to Source · Delete · Edit parameters (due date, priority, notes)
* Batch: Postpone / Advance / Forget / Remove from Queue / Suspend / Restore / Delete

!! Keyboard Shortcuts

* Review: [[1]] Again · [[2]] Hard · [[3]] Good · [[4]] Easy · [[Space]] Flip/Unfold · [[p]] Stop study · [[n]] Next · [[e]] Remove from queue · [[u]] Unfold
* Reading: [[←]] / [[→]] Previous / Next section · [[Alt+K]] Omni Creator · [[Alt+X]] Extract · [[Alt+Z]] Cloze · [[Alt+Q]] Q&A · [[Ctrl+F7]] Set Read Point · [[Alt+F7]] Jump to Read Point · [[Shift+Ctrl+F7]] Clear Read Point

> Principle (from SuperMemo): Take a lightweight action on every item (Read / Later / Ignore / Extract), never idle;
> Never fear high import volume—the system schedules items according to priority.
